sentences.en: The tolerance of ambiguities is necessary in learning a language.
sentences.zh: 在学习语言的过程中，容忍模棱两可的情况是必要的。

sentences.en: Lucy was surprised at the ambiguity of his language.
sentences.zh: 露西对他言语中的含糊不清感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Some young Koreans express more sexual ambiguity in their music videos.
sentences.zh: 一些年轻的韩国人在他们的音乐视频中表达了更多的性取向模糊性。

senses.zh: 含糊,意义不明确,含糊的话，模棱两可的话,可作两种或多种解释
